question.text: What will be the combined voteshare of PP and PSOE in the 2026 Spanish General Election?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the combined voteshare of PP and PSOE in the 2026 Spanish Congress of Deputies Election.
question.fine_print:
If results are not yet finalised, this question will resolve based upon the most complete results available before 2027.

PSOE includes PSC. 
PP includes coalitions in which PP is the lead partner, such as PP-Foro in Asturias.

research:
## 1. Resolution source

- The question resolves on the official Congress of Deputies results for the 29 November 2026 election. Those would come from the Ministry of the Interior / resultados.eleccionesgenerales results site, and later from the Junta Electoral Central (JEC). No results exist yet, because the election is four weeks away. I did not fetch a results page, since none has been published for 2026.
- 2023-07-23: Last general election (final figures from memory, not re-fetched): PP 33.05% plus PSOE (with PSC) 31.68% = **about 64.7%** combined. This is the reference point.

## 2. Current status

- Nothing settles the question yet. The vote is on 2026-11-29, so the result will come in well before the 2027 cutoff.
- 2026-10-05: Sánchez dissolved the Cortes and called elections for 29 November after Congress rejected his housing decrees. [Diario de León](https://www.diariodeleon.es/nacional/261005/2099307/ultima-hora-sanchez-convoca-elecciones-generales-29-noviembre-crisis-decretos-vivienda.html), [Artículo14](https://www.articulo14.es/politica/pedro-sanchez-convoca-elecciones-generales-anticipadas-el-29-de-noviembre-20261005.html)
- The official campaign runs from 13 November until a day of reflection on 28 November (reported by ABC via the news API; I could not open the page to check).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

**Train crash:**
- 2026-10-31 and 11-01: The Urda (Toledo) high-speed train crash on 27 October killed at least 69 people, nine months after the Adamuz crash killed 46. Reports say it upended the PSOE's positive campaign and has led to calls for the transport minister to resign. Feijóo is reported to be avoiding exploiting it. [infoLibre](https://www.infolibre.es/politica/tragedia-ferroviaria-rompe-campana-amor-sanchez-da-alas-derecha-mes-29n_1_2239358.html), [Diario de Sevilla](https://www.diariodesevilla.es/andalucia/feijoo-evita-exprimir-tragedia-sanchez_0_2008397768.html)
- 2026-11-01: As far as I could find, there is no published national poll with fieldwork entirely after Urda. EM-Analytics (28-30 Oct) is the only one partly after it. [electografica](https://www.electografica.com/2026/11/encuesta-sondaxe-261101.html), [Demócrata](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/agregado-encuestas-antes-urda-pp-psoe-vox-29n/)

**Polls.** These come from the [Wikipedia polling table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_next_Spanish_general_election); the PP+PSOE sums are my own arithmetic. Fieldwork dates are given first.

| Fieldwork | Pollster | PP | PSOE | PP+PSOE |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 28-30 Oct | EM-Analytics | 31.5 | 25.8 | **57.3** |
| 26-28 Oct | Sondaxe/La Voz de Galicia | 29.2 | 26.9 | **56.1** ([Demócrata](https://democrata.es/politica/encuesta-sondaxe-pp-aventaja-psoe-en-23-puntos-vox-alcanza-192-mes-elecciones)) |
| 27 Oct | Vox internal poll, published by The Objective | 28.1 | 29.6 | **57.7** ([Demócrata](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/encuesta-elecciones-generales-sondeo-interno-vox-anterior-urda-situa-psoe-por-delante-pp-pero-mantiene-mayoria-derecha/)) |
| 25 Oct | PSOE internal poll | 29 | 30 | **59.0** |
| 1 Sep-25 Oct | SocioMétrica | 32.4 | 27.0 | **59.4** |
| 22-24 Oct | NC Report | 33.1 | 25.8 | **58.9** |
| 21-23 Oct | Winston | 29.4 | 27.1 | **56.5** |
| 20-22 Oct | Ateneo del Dato | 31.1 | 27.6 | **58.7** |
| 8-22 Oct | Sigma Dos | 30.6 | 26.1 | **56.7** ([Demócrata](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/encuesta-elecciones-generales-sigma-dos-pp-psoe-vox-octubre/)) |
| 13-16 Oct | IMOP | 28.5 | 27.1 | **55.6** ([Demócrata](https://www.democrata.es/en/center-of-surveys-and-electoral-polls/general-elections/general-elections-survey-the-pp-drops-to-28-5-and-the-psoe-narrows-the-gap-to-27-1-according-to-imop/)) |
| 1-6 Oct | CIS | 28.0 | 28.0 | **56.0** |

Spread of the other early-October polls: GESOP 54.8 (the lowest), 40dB 60.0, InvyMark 60.8, DYM 62.2 (the highest).

- Pre-Urda aggregate (Demócrata, closed 27 Oct): PP 31.0, PSOE 27.3, Vox 18.9, so PP+PSOE = **58.3**. [Demócrata](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/agregado-encuestas-antes-urda-pp-psoe-vox-29n/)
- Across about 25 October polls, PP+PSOE ranges from 54.8 to 62.2, with a median around 57.5 to 58. Vox polls steadily at about 18 to 20%, and Frente Amplio/Sumar at 5 to 9%.

## 4. Base rates

PP+PSOE combined share in past general elections (from memory, not re-fetched):

| Election | PP+PSOE |
|---|---|
| 2008 | about 83.8 |
| 2011 | about 73.4 |
| 2015 | about 50.7 (28.7 + 22.0) |
| 2016 | about 55.7 (33.0 + 22.6) |
| Apr 2019 | about 45.4 (16.7 + 28.7) |
| Nov 2019 | about 48.8 (20.8 + 28.0) |
| 2023 | about 64.7 |

- The 2026 polls imply a drop of about 6 to 8 points from 2023, mostly because Vox is up from 12.4% to about 19%.
- Poll error: in 2023 the final polls had the PSOE about 3 points too low and the PP slightly too high. From memory, the combined PP+PSOE poll average was roughly 1 to 3 points below the actual result. Pollsters disagree in the final month, by up to about 7 points on the combined figure.

## 5. Other forecasts and markets

Prices as of 2026-11-01:
- **Kalshi, PSOE vote share:** at least 26% = 0.67, at least 27% = 0.48, at least 28% = 0.32. That puts the implied median at about 27%.
- **Kalshi, Vox:** at least 19% = 0.51, so the implied median is about 19%.
- **Kalshi, PP+Vox at least 50%:** 0.55, which suggests a PP median around 31%.
- Taken together, the markets imply PP+PSOE of roughly **58%**. That is my inference; Kalshi has no direct market on the combined share.
- **Polymarket, winner:** PP 0.845, PSOE 0.155.
- I found no Metaculus or Manifold market on the combined share.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution

- Fallout from the Urda crash: the first fully post-crash polls are expected in early November. A possible ministerial resignation could hurt the PSOE or push left-wing voters to rally behind it.
- 2026-11-13: The official campaign starts. Televised debates are likely, though I found no confirmed dates.
- Late November: Spain usually bans publishing polls in the final 5 days, so the last ones should appear around 2026-11-23.
- 2026-11-29: Election day, with the provisional count the same night.
- Tactical "useful vote" consolidation behind the PP and PSOE has historically raised their combined share compared with polls, as happened in 2023.

Sources: [Wikipedia polling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_for_the_next_Spanish_general_election), [Demócrata aggregate](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/agregado-encuestas-antes-urda-pp-psoe-vox-29n/), [Demócrata Sigma Dos](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/encuesta-elecciones-generales-sigma-dos-pp-psoe-vox-octubre/), [Demócrata Sondaxe](https://democrata.es/politica/encuesta-sondaxe-pp-aventaja-psoe-en-23-puntos-vox-alcanza-192-mes-elecciones), [Demócrata IMOP](https://www.democrata.es/en/center-of-surveys-and-electoral-polls/general-elections/general-elections-survey-the-pp-drops-to-28-5-and-the-psoe-narrows-the-gap-to-27-1-according-to-imop/), [Demócrata Vox internal](https://www.democrata.es/encuestas/elecciones-generales/encuesta-elecciones-generales-sondeo-interno-vox-anterior-urda-situa-psoe-por-delante-pp-pero-mantiene-mayoria-derecha/), [electografica](https://www.electografica.com/2026/11/encuesta-sondaxe-261101.html), [Diario de León](https://www.diariodeleon.es/nacional/261005/2099307/ultima-hora-sanchez-convoca-elecciones-generales-29-noviembre-crisis-decretos-vivienda.html), [Artículo14](https://www.articulo14.es/politica/pedro-sanchez-convoca-elecciones-generales-anticipadas-el-29-de-noviembre-20261005.html), [infoLibre](https://www.infolibre.es/politica/tragedia-ferroviaria-rompe-campana-amor-sanchez-da-alas-derecha-mes-29n_1_2239358.html), [Diario de Sevilla](https://www.diariodesevilla.es/andalucia/feijoo-evita-exprimir-tragedia-sanchez_0_2008397768.html)

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source will be the official Congress results from Spain's Interior Ministry (resultados.elecciones / infoelectoral). The fine print says PSOE includes PSC, and PP includes coalitions it leads, such as PP-UPN and PP-Foro. Vote shares are percentages of valid votes, which include blank ballots.
- 2026-11-01: The election has not happened yet, so there are no official results. Voting day is 29 November 2026, and the official campaign runs from 13 November. forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** The election is on 29 November 2026, about 4 weeks away. Near-final provisional results will be available that night, well before the 2027 cutoff.

(b) **Latest known value:** No 2026 results exist yet. The last official figure is from the 23 July 2023 election, where PP 33.05% plus PSOE 31.68% gave about 64.7% combined. The current poll aggregate (Demócrata, before the Urda crash, closed 27 October) puts PP+PSOE at 58.3%. Across October polls the median is about 57.5 to 58, with a range of 54.8 to 62.2.

(c) **If nothing changed:** About 58% combined, roughly 31 for PP and 27 for PSOE.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** Late-October polls are flat to slightly lower, around 56 to 58. The Urda crash may cost the PSOE votes, but some of those may go to the PP rather than to smaller parties. Late "useful vote" consolidation behind the two big parties usually pushes their combined share up, as in 2023, when final polls were roughly 1 to 3 points below the actual combined result. Net effect: about 58 to 59.

(e) **Historical variation:** Over a final month, the combined PP+PSOE share in polls typically moves 1 to 3 points. Errors in the final poll average on the combined figure have been about 1 to 3 points. Pollsters currently disagree by up to 7 points.

(f) **Experts and markets:** Kalshi implies a PSOE median of about 27%, a Vox median of about 19%, and PP+Vox at 50% or more at 0.55, which suggests a PP median near 31%. Taken together, the markets point to roughly 58% combined. Polymarket gives the PP about an 85% chance of finishing first.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** The Urda crash fallout collapses the PSOE to about 23 to 24%. Vox surges past 21% and the left fragments, leaving a combined share of about 52 to 53.
- **High:** Strong two-party polarization in the final week, with the left rallying to the PSOE (about 30) and right-wing voters consolidating behind the PP (about 33). That would give a combined share of about 63 to 65, close to 2023.

I set the median at about 58.8, slightly above the poll and market figure of 58 to allow for the historical consolidation effect, with a standard deviation of about 3 points.
